text:
morgan: Deploybot flagged canary publish for image gcr.io/redwood/runtime:staging-2026-03-14 — holding.

deploybot: [automated] publish-hold: annotation parity check failed between index manifests for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. details:
```
Platform: linux/amd64 annotations: {buildid: "b-1245", provenance: "attest-20260314"}
Platform: linux/arm64 annotations: {buildid: "b-1246", provenance: "attest-20260313"}
```

sasha: ugh, arm64 push looks like it didn't pick up the attestation overlay. devops, did the canary pipeline run twice?

devon: yeah we had a retry on the arm build earlier, cosign step might have skipped. checking logs now.

devon: `gcrane manifest inspect gcr.io/redwood/runtime:staging-2026-03-14 --platform=linux/arm64 | jq .annotations`

release-coordinator: what's the rollback plan if we can't reconcile? customers expect canary by EOD.

morgan: prefer pin to last-known-good digest and re-run attestation step for arm64. avoid retagging same tag until resolved. :no_entry_sign: 

sasha: agree. last-known-good digest is `sha256:7f4a9c3b2e5f6d1a9c0b3a4567890def1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef` from yesterday. we can promote that after change window.

deploybot: noted. canary publish remains held. suggested action: `pin -> gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:7f4a9c3b2e5f6d1a9c0b3a4567890def1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef`, update release notes to mention fallback, schedule republish for 02:00 UTC change window.

release-coordinator: schedule OK for 02:00 UTC — add to release notes and PSA to #support. I'll add a line.

morgan: devon, once cosign attestation is fixed, create a new build with a fresh tag and request canary again. no manual retags on the pinned digest.

devon: on it. I'll run attestation workflow and post logs here.

sasha: if cosign skip was due to timeout, bump timeout and retry. Also create a tiny smoke test for arm64 manifest annotations.

release-coordinator: noted. I'll update the release checklist: pinned-digest, support-psa, republish-window, postmortem if root cause persists. :spiral_note_pad: 

morgan: thanks team. marking thread resolved when republish goes green.
